description: Fire-resistance rating and sound rating the 2024 Ontario Building Code Part 9 requires for a wall between dwelling units: a party wall on a property line (townhouse, semi-detached), a wall between suites in one building, a house with a secondary suite, or a garage wall. Source: 2024 Ontario Building Code (O. Reg. 163/24), Division B, Articles 9.10.8.1., 9.10.9.15., 9.10.9.16., 9.10.9.18., 9.10.11.1. to 9.10.11.4., 9.11.1.1. and 9.11.1.3., and Article 3.1.10.2. to 3.1.10.5.

garage_serves_dwelling.description: Does the garage serve only the dwelling it is attached to? Used for garage-dwelling only.

sprinklered.description: Is the house with a secondary suite sprinklered? Used for the secondary-suite case only.

two_storey_unit.description: Does a dwelling unit have 2 or more storeys, counting the basement?

unit_above_unit.description: Is any dwelling unit above another dwelling unit (stacked units)?

wall_use.description: What the wall separates: party-wall (dwelling units on either side of a property line, such as townhouses or semi-detached houses), suites (units in one building with no property line, such as a duplex, triplex or stacked units), secondary-suite (a house with a secondary suite), garage-garage (two attached garages across a property line), garage-dwelling (a garage and the dwelling it serves).

name: firewall_and_party_wall_fire_rating_checker
title: Firewall and Party Wall Fire Rating Checker
